assessment.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

H1.evidence: Outcome-free range/PCA distance shifts plus frozen contribution/error diagnostics align; this is predictive/mechanical evidence, not an identified causal effect.
H1.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

H2.evidence: Oracle level correction removes 27.3% of excess joint loss; level drift exists but does not explain most failure.
H2.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

H3.hypothesis: Payoff macro coefficients are temporally unstable
H3.evidence: Coarse-window payoff signs/magnitudes change, including rate/HPI associations. Different populations and correlated predictors limit interpretation.
H3.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

H4.hypothesis: Default macro relationships are temporally unstable
H4.evidence: Default coefficient changes and 2020 ranking deterioration are visible; the late diagnostic window has only 43 defaults and no coefficient confidence intervals.
H4.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

H5.evidence: Distinct-month correlation geometry and VIF change, consistent with unstable mappings; its separate contribution to failure is not identified.
H5.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

H6.evidence: Age/vintage composition and nonmacro coefficient allocation shift; disjoint roles prevent interpreting split differences as matched-facility attrition or causal APC identification.
H6.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

H7.evidence: 2020 drives much of the aggregate error, but frozen proper-score deterioration and opposite-direction payoff underprediction persist after 2022.
H7.label: POST_VALIDATION_DIAGNOSTIC

root_cause_ranking.mechanism: Out-of-support macro mapping with nonlinear payoff-tail amplification
root_cause_ranking.evidence: Pandemic unemployment/rate contributions and frozen ablations align with the 2020 payoff excess and cumulative exit overshoot.
Window sign reversals and overprediction in 2020 followed by underprediction after 2022; not an identified causal attribution.
Joint intercept oracle removes 27.3% of excess loss and leaves substantial residual deterioration.
Exact frozen logit decomposition exposes structural coefficient redistribution, but APC components remain unidentified.
Predictor geometry changes; direct attribution of score deterioration to correlation changes is unresolved.

root_cause_ranking.mechanism: Pandemic alone or global intercept error alone

limitations: All findings are post-validation/exploratory; no confirmatory validation or model promotion.
Macro paths are common calendar observations, not millions of independent macro samples; PSI/KS are descriptive with no threshold invalidity claims.
Mahalanobis distance uses a development covariance pseudoinverse; its reference quantile is descriptive, not a Gaussian coverage guarantee.
Frozen ablations and component substitutions are mathematical diagnostics, not causal interventions; correlated contributions and nonlinear responses are nonadditive.
M1/M2 structural coefficients differ; their full logit gap cannot be attributed exclusively to macros.
Diagnostic windows have different composition and identifiability; late defaults number only 43. Coefficient confidence intervals are not estimated.
APC components, policy changes, borrower clustering and behavioral causes are not identified.
Disjoint facility roles and delayed entry mean composition comparisons are not matched-facility survival estimates.
Oracle offsets use the same evaluation outcomes and are optimistically biased; they provide no independently validated corrected model.
CIF paths use subsequently observed historical PIT macro information; they are not prospective t0 forecasts. Prior censoring assumptions remain unverified.
Mortgage operational knowledge timing remains unverified; fairness, regulatory PD, EAD, LGD and ECL are not established.
